Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 04-Feb-2025 (01:00 PM - 04:00 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  FIRST SEMESTER B.TECH. (CORE/CSE STREAM) EXAMINATIONS - FEBRUARY 2025  
  SUBJECT: CIE_1072 - ENVIRONMENTAL STUDIES  
  (MAKEUP)  
  Environmental Studies [CIE-1072]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                      Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1A)               Explain how the ozone hole issue has evolved and how it has been resolved.                             (5)  
1B)               Commons property cannot be always renewable or dependable. Justify.                                    (3)  
1C)               In Sundarbans, rising sea levels have turned farms into wasteland. Explain.                            (2)  
2A)               Explain the different classifications of forests in India.                                             (5)  
2B)               Argue that the term watershed is not defined in terms of scale by elucidating three sub-divisions of   (3)  
  watersheds.  
2C)               Classification of a resource as renewable or non-renewable is subjective to the time-scale             (2)  
  considered. Defend this statement.  
3A)               Explain the importance of Air quality index in the assessment of pollution.                            (5)  
3B)               Discuss the impact of salinization and nutrient deposition on water bodies.                            (3)  
3C)               Differentiate between physical and economic scarcity of water.                                         (2)  
4A)               Protection of environment is a mutual responsibility of citizen and state. Justify.                    (5)  
4B)               Discuss the commitment and initiative taken by India in ecosystem restoration.                         (3)  
4C)               Explain the provisions made in environmental legislation towards addressing the safe and healthy       (2)  
  working environment.  
5A)               Differentiate pre-disaster phase from a post disaster phase in assessing the Disaster management       (5)  
  cycle.  
5B)               Explain the extremities of flood and drought in Chennai and its consequences.                          (3)  
5C)               Discuss the responsibilities of National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA).                         (2)  
  
  
  -----End-----
